BLI 2944G80819 is the program's own line rather than a rollup; the competing owner 0203735A is the RDT&E 'Combat Vehicle Improvement Programs' rollup, which a vehicle delivery modification on procurement money does not fund.

refute_a.reason: The paragraph names fiscal 2025 weapons and tracked combat vehicle procurement, the appropriation behind 2944G80819's 2033A; the lake reports no funding accounts for W56HZV23C0024, which the money-color guard treats as unknown rather than mismatched, and delivering Armored Multi-Purpose Vehicles is this single-program line's own end item.

refute_b.reason: The name collides verbatim — 'The Armored Multi-Purpose Vehicle (AMPV)' is an index row at both 0203735A and 2944G80819 — and the announcement's name evidence is only four words, so this is the closest call in the chunk; it survives because the stated fiscal 2025 weapons and tracked combat vehicle procurement funding cannot reach 0203735A, an RDT&E rollup that separately owns 'AMPV Improvement Program' for the work it does fund.

proposals.announcement_evidence: 1,259 M1151A1B1 High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicles (HMMWVs); and 414 M1152A1B2 Troop Enclosure HMMWVs in support of Afghanistan
proposals.rationale: The vehicles are named by designator and the line 3446D15400 is the Army's HMMWV procurement BLI, but the announcement states the buy is 'in support of Afghanistan' — a partner-force vehicle buy, typically funded through the Afghanistan Security Forces Fund rather than the Army's own HMMWV line, and the paragraph says only 'other procurement funds' without identifying the account. Vehicles bought for a foreign force are not this line's own work, so the attribution claim is not supported.

proposals.announcement_evidence: for fire control radar systems
proposals.rationale: 'Fire control radar systems' is a generic category phrase, and although Longbow LLC builds the Apache fire control radar, the announcement obligates fiscal 2025 Foreign Military Sales funds in full — the work is executed for a foreign customer, not out of the AH-64 Apache Block IIIA Reman line's appropriation. The index row 'Fire Control Radar (FCR)' also sits inside a remanufacture line that buys aircraft, not standalone radars for FMS cases, so even the program fit is uncertain.

proposals.announcement_evidence: 48 vehicle sets of self-propelled howitzer and carrier, ammunition, tracked vehicles and associated support
proposals.rationale: Same contract as record 32, but this paragraph drops the M109A7 and M992A3 designators and describes the end items only generically as 'self-propelled howitzer and carrier, ammunition, tracked vehicles' — wording that fits the M109 FOV Modifications line's A6/A2 pairing as readily as PIM's A7/A3 pairing. The announcement also reports 'other procurement, Army' funds rather than the weapons-and-tracked-combat-vehicle appropriation PIM draws on. Without the designators, the evidence in this record does not carry the attribution on its own.

proposals.announcement_evidence: Mobile Protected Firepower middle tier acquisition and rapid prototyping effort with low-rate initial production options
proposals.rationale: The General Dynamics half of the same MPF prototyping competition as record 59. The program name is exact and owned by 7181G80820, but the obligation is fiscal 2018 and 2019 research, development, test and evaluation funds for a middle-tier rapid prototyping effort, with production only as options — RDT&E work booked against a procurement line, which the rubric rejects.

proposals.announcement_evidence: the Stryker Infantry Carrier Vehicle (ICV) 30mm lethality upgrade
proposals.rationale: 0203735A carries 'Stryker Infantry Carrier Vehicles (ICV)' as a verbatim name match to the announcement, which is why it has to be recorded — but the PE is the rollup 'Combat Vehicle Improvement Programs', covering AMPV, embedded training software and target-acquisition items alongside Stryker ICV, and the rubric treats a rollup owner as a refutation. The award also mixes 'other procurement (Army)' with RDT&E funds, so no single line's money color is asserted by the paragraph.

proposals.announcement_evidence: the Stryker Infantry Carrier Vehicle (ICV) 30mm lethality upgrade
proposals.rationale: 0363G85200 ('Stryker Upgrade') owns the 30mm-armed ICV under its programmatic names — 'Medium Caliber Weapon System (MCWS)', 'Contractor Logistics Support for ICVVA1-30mm (MCWS)' and 'Infantry Carrier Vehicle (ICVVA1)' — so it is the better mission fit than the RDT&E rollup. But neither MCWS nor ICVVA1 appears in the announcement, and this 2016 award is the earlier 30mm lethality upgrade for a single regiment, not the later MCWS program of record the narrative describes; the identification rests on inference about which effort the words name.

proposals.announcement_evidence: low-rate initial production of the M10 Booker
proposals.rationale: The announcement names the M10 Booker exactly as the index row and the BLI title do, and the action is low-rate initial production of the vehicle itself — the line's own end item, not a platform the contract supports. The obligation is fiscal 2023 and 2024 weapons and tracked combat vehicle procurement, the appropriation this procurement BLI draws on, which distinguishes it cleanly from the earlier RDT&E-funded MPF prototyping awards on the same contract number (records 59 and 76, recorded weak for exactly that reason). No other PE in this index carries the M10 Booker name.

refute_a.reason: Fiscal 2023-24 weapons and tracked combat vehicle procurement is stated and the lake confirms 021-2033 on W56HZV19C0036, matching 7181G80820's 2033A; low-rate initial production of the M10 Booker is the line's own production work, which also separates this action cleanly from the RDTE-funded MPF prototyping actions carried on the same contract number.

refute_b.reason: 'M10 BOOKER' and 'Mobile Protected Firepower (MPF)' are owned by 7181G80820 and by no other PE in the index; the paragraph names the vehicle exactly as the row does and describes its low-rate initial production, so there is no alternative owner, no invented alias and no competing variant or increment.
